title: Dereth Town Tour - Sanamar Royal Hall scratch

shots.standingOrder: Truck slowly sideways along the north wall of the Royal Hall at head height, 12 m off the gate towers, with the great spires rising behind.
shots.notes: FACADE PAN (classic.truck; the single Sanamar pan, distinctive Viamontian keep). Camera 2.9 m above the plateau and 11.9 m off the north gate towers (0x01003AA5 archway towers, 23.5 m) trucking 36 m west at <= 4.7 m/s with a fixed 20 deg up-tilt on a 65 deg lens: the gate, the three-storey curtain wall and the four-storey corner tower slide past while the red-domed 84 m spires of the Royal Hall rise behind them. Flat ground z 80, open lawn, nothing within 9.6 m of the camera line. Verified offline (real registry build + WBT terrain): start (9498.0,41310.0,82.9) end (9462.0,41310.0,82.9), min AGL 2.9 m, nearest static/building/tree 9.6 m (0x02001293@9494,41321), peak 4.7 m/s; WBT get-height at 5 path samples matched the checker terrain to 0.00 m.

shots.standingOrder: Spiral down from high over the sea cliffs toward the red-domed spires of the Royal Hall, staying outside a 55 m radius and above 140 m.
shots.notes: HERO (drone.spiral-descent; JEV-eligible). Starts 202 m up over the southern sea cliffs, spiralling 65 deg counter-clockwise while closing from 100 to 60 m radius and descending to z 144: the four red-domed 21/22-storey spires (top 163.6) and the two 12-storey towers (134.6) grow out of the cliff-top palace with the sea on three sides. Ends 9.4 m above the 12-storey roofs and 20.8 m from the nearest tower bounds. Verified offline (real registry build + WBT terrain): start (9445.8,41138.0,202.0) end (9522.3,41189.4,144.0), min AGL 64.0 m, nearest static/building/tree 20.8 m (0x31D6#1 0x01003911), peak 11.4 m/s; WBT get-height at 5 path samples matched the checker terrain to 0.00 m.

shots.standingOrder: Orbit the Royal Hall slowly at 180 m while the sky clock races toward golden hour and the clouds stream over the sea.
shots.notes: CLIMAX (drone.hyperlapse-orbit, assigned). Orbit radius 140 m at z 175 (11 m above the spire tops) clockwise 47 deg from NNE while the sky clock runs 80x (16 s = 1280 sky-s = 0.17 day): the sun sinks from 75 deg to ~23 deg in the west (0.66 -> 0.83, always up), clouds stream over the sea and the light turns gold across the palace; ends looking WSW into the golden sun over the sea.
